items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: Yeah, that was Sunday morning, yeah, yeah. I enjoyed him. I enjoyed the session, you know, we played, it was an hour, just one hour, from Shakespeare's Park to Robertson Street

ctx.x: Oh yeah, well I was there the other day for Sonny Henry, you know. What about that Sunday, that day, what was it, was it a Sunday you told me about where you met Dave Bailey there on the church?

Yeah, that was Sunday morning, yeah, yeah. I enjoyed him. I enjoyed the session, you know, we played, it was an hour, just one hour, from Shakespeare's Park to Robertson Street, Robertson, Louisiana Avenue. Yeah, I know that church. Some church there, I mean. And both bands met up.
